summary: Scully Royalty Ltd., a Shanghai-based mineral royalty trader and foreign private issuer, disclosed via Form 6-K that a requisitioning group of members holding 20% of voting rights demanded an Extraordinary General Meeting. The board convened the EGM for January 12, 2027, 10:00 a.m. Hong Kong time at Dina House, Hong Kong, to vote on resolutions in the requisition; full resolution text will appear in the board's later meeting notice under Article 16.5 of the articles. Mechanism mirrors a US proxy fight; no terms, advisors, or board recommendation were provided. Watch for the notice's resolution wording and any board response, which will signal the campaign's real objective.
